pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Treegrid with row focus: rows carry aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-expanded (summary tasks), and aria-rowindex (virtual rows); one roving tab stop. The grid is the accessible surface: every value a bar shows (dates, duration, milestone, critical, dependencies, violations, baseline variance) is text in its row. The timeline and histogram tracks are aria-hidden pointer surfaces with keyboard and toolbar equivalents for every action (WCAG 2.5.7).

roles.role: treegrid, named by aria-label, described by the instructions

aria.value: 1-based index including the header (rows are virtual)
0 on the focused row, -1 on the others
Link while picking a successor / true when an action is not possible (buttons stay focusable)
Polite: new dates after a change, scale, undone, redone, linking cancelled. Assertive: linking instructions, linked, unlinked, refused, cannot be changed, limited by dependencies.

keyboard.action: Toolbar buttons, then the grid (one tab stop: the focused row).
Next / previous visible task (the grid scrolls; virtual rows render).
One page down / up; first / last task.
Expand a collapsed summary; on an expanded one, move to its first child.
Collapse an expanded summary; otherwise move to the parent.
Activate (aui-task-activate); while linking, make this task the successor (or remove the existing link between the two).
Move the task one working day later / earlier (reading direction in RTL). Announces the new dates, or that dependencies prevent an earlier start.
Lengthen / shorten by one working day (at least one day).

focus: One roving tab stop over the rows; the focused row stays rendered while the grid scrolls (virtual rows). Collapsing a summary moves focus to it from a hidden child. Changes keep focus on the edited row; toolbar actions apply to the focused row and leave focus on the button. Clicking a bar focuses its row.
wcag: 1.4.10 Reflow (two-dimensional chart scrolls in its own container)
notes: Critical tasks are marked with the text 'Critical' in the grid and a hatched bar; milestones with 'Milestone'.
Dependencies and baseline variance are visually hidden text in the name cell, read with the row.
The histogram's peak load and over-capacity days are visible text next to each resource.
knownCaveats: Pointer drags are not announced until the change is applied.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
